market_holds: Spot $9.315 sealed 2026-11-13 (baseline), 64.7% below the 52-week high and 3% above the low ($9.04 close on 10-30, Yahoo bars). The front-week straddle gives 8.64%, about 6.2% net of ordinary volatility. Skew is -3.3 vol points (calls richer than puts) and put/call OI is 0.38, so options lean slightly to upside. Short interest is 45.8m shares, about 4.8% of float, 7.4 days to cover (FINRA 10-30, sweep row). Over the last 5 sessions the stock fell 9% (10.24 to 9.36), but NIO fell 14%, LI 7% and KWEB 8% over the same days, so the drop is sector and ADR beta, not news about XPEV. Already public: Q3 deliveries of 118,390, at the midpoint of the 115-121k guide; the Q3 revenue guide of RMB21.7-23.4bn; a record October of 50,237 (+20% YoY, overseas 13,326); the Mona L05 launch on Oct 29, with a 10k first-month target; and the CEO's August target of more than 60k a month in Q4 with overseas above 40k a quarter. Vehicle margin was 12.1% in both Q1 and Q2 and gross margin 20.7%, helped by VW services. A Q3 revenue 'consensus' of about $3.85bn (Earnings Whispers, 11-09) sits above the top of the guide and looks unreliable. I found no Q4 delivery or revenue consensus. The line it trades on is the guide: the last four prints moved -10.3% (2025-11-17, weak Q4 revenue guide), -8.4% (2026-03-20, Q1 delivery guide far below the street), -0.1% (2026-05-28, Q2 guide above consensus) and -8.5% (2026-08-24, weak Q3 guide).
view: This print turns on the Q4 guide, deliveries and revenue, set against a CEO target of more than 60k a month and a record October of 50k. Management's guides have repeatedly come in below the street: three of the last four reactions were drops of 8-10% on the guide. Management also has a credibility gap, having missed its own Q4 2025 delivery guide (125-132k guided, 116k delivered), and its 550-600k 2026 target is out of reach (334,604 year to date through October). China's market is weak: CPCA puts October NEV retail at -13.7% YoY. A Q4 guide that implies November and December below 60k a month, or a revenue-per-vehicle decline from the cheaper Mona mix, would repeat the August pattern. Against that, the stock is already near its 52-week low after a beta-driven 9% fall this week, short interest is modest, options lean slightly to upside, and a Q4 guide of roughly 165-175k would be a record quarter of 40-50% YoY growth. Q3 vehicle margin may also recover from 12.1% now that the generation changeover is done. I could not find the street's Q4 number, and China's weekly registration data is no longer published publicly, so I cannot measure November against the 60k target. Without either, the guide-disappointment pattern is a soft prior and not a mechanism I can show is unpriced. I lean slightly down.

recommendation.reason: The reaction will turn on the Q4 delivery and revenue guide against a street figure I could not find, and November-to-date volume data is not publicly available. The repeated pattern of guides below the street favours the downside only mildly, and depressed positioning and call-leaning options offset it. No dated evidence shows the price failing to hold something.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: A Q4 delivery guide at or above about 170k (consistent with 60k+ a month in November and December), with Q3 vehicle margin recovering above 13%, would make the near-low price look too pessimistic and favour up.

self_critique: The guide-disappointment pattern is well known to holders and may already be in a stock 65% off its high and near its lows, after a fresh 9% beta-driven drop. October's record and the sold-out L05 give management room to guide to a record quarter of 165k+, which could squeeze a stock with depressed sentiment, and the option skew already leans that way. Equally, I cannot rule out a soft guide in a China market down double digits YoY. Taken together, the evidence is close to a coin flip.
approach_notes: P6 (find the line: the guide) and checking the last reactions myself from bars were the most useful steps. P3's 'freshest data first' hit a wall because China's weekly registration series is no longer public, and the playbook offers no fallback when the decisive series is unavailable.
